The '''84th Stormtrooper Legion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Legion/Legends|legion]] that contained [[Talon Company]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Legion attacked [[Arda Base]].<ref name="OAA1" />
